test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 02 Feb 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: The compound interest on a sum of ₹2,300 at the rate of 10% per annum for a certain period is ₹483. Find the period in years.
solution:
Given:

Compound interest = ₹ 483

Principle = 2300

Rate of interest = 10 %

Formula used:

C.I = P[(1 + R/100)T - 1]

Here, P = Sum, T = Time, And R = Rate

Calculation:

A = 483 + 2300 = 2783

According to the question,

2783 = 2300[(1 + 10/100)ⁿ]

⇒ 2783 = 2300[(1 + 1/10)n ]

⇒ 2783/2300 = P[(11/10)n ]

⇒ 121/100 = P(11/10)n ]

⇒ (11/10)² = P(11/10)n ]

Comparing both,

n = 2 years.

**The answer is 2 years.**
